description: To learn about role of AI in security. To implement AI models for handling cyber security tasks and different types of attacks. To understand different types of attacks on AI systems.

syllabus.title: Fundamentals of AI and Security
syllabus.body: Overview of AI with use cases from cyber security, classification of threats, attacks, vulnerabilities, malware, Trojans etc.

syllabus.title: Classification of Malwares
syllabus.body: Supervised and unsupervised learning based on signatures and profiling, Decision Tree, SVM and its variants, BBN and context based malicious event detection.

syllabus.title: Time Series Analysis for Security
syllabus.body: Time series analysis, different types of ensemble learning to detect abnormal behavior, reconnaissance detection - case study.

syllabus.title: AI for Anomaly Detection in Networks
syllabus.body: Network anomaly detection; pipeline of network attack, deep neural architectures for detection and prognosis of attacks, designing intrusion detection systems.

syllabus.title: Attacks on AI Systems
syllabus.body: Adversarial attacks, white box attacks, black box attacks, model poisoning.

outcomes: Students will be able to develop AI models for classification of malwares.
Students will be able to implement intrusion detection systems using deep neural architecture.
Students will be able to detect vulnerabilities in AI systems.
textbooks: Halder, Soma, and Sinan Ozdemir, Hands-On Machine Learning for Cybersecurity, Packt Publishing Ltd, 2018.
Sikos, Leslie F., ed., AI in Cybersecurity, Vol. 151, Springer, 2018.
referenceBooks: David Freeman, Clarence Chi, Machine Learning and Security, O'Reilly Media, 2018.
